ja: －－－　劇中のキュベレイの攻撃シーンを再現！ ファンネル射出シーンをディスプレイ！　－－－
ファンネルが射出した軌跡を再現するエフェクトとスタンドがセットになって登場！
※この商品にＭＳ本体は含まれません。
「ＨＧＵＣ NO.195 キュベレイ」（※別売）とジョイントして、劇中のファンネル射出シーンを再現するエフェクトと、
空中シーンのディスプレイポーズに欠かせないスタンドをセットにし、エフェクトセットとして商品化。
・　エフェクトは、クリアブルー成形で、ファンネルの躍動感ある軌跡を表現！
エフェクトは２つのパーツから構成され、途中で角度を変えた表現が可能。
・　クリア成形のスタンドが付属！
空中シーンのディスプレイポーズに欠かせないスタンドがクリア成形で付属。
肩部に大型のバインダーをもつＭＳ本体を、バランスよくポージング固定できる専用ジョイントが付属。

●ファンネル軌跡エフェクト　× 一式　　　●クリアスタンド　× １

en: --- Reproduce the attack scene of Cybele in the movie! Display funnel injection scene! ---
Introducing a set of effects and a stand that reproduce the trajectory of the funnel!
*This product does not include the MS body.
An effect that reproduces the funnel injection scene in the play by jointing with "HGUC NO.195 Qubeley" (*sold separately),
The set includes a stand that is essential for display poses in aerial scenes, and is commercialized as an effect set.
- The effect is made of clear blue molding to express the dynamic trajectory of the funnel!
The effect consists of two parts, and it is possible to change the angle in the middle.
・Comes with a clear molded stand!
A clear molded stand is included, which is essential for display poses in aerial scenes.
A special joint is included that allows you to pose the MS body with a large binder on the shoulder in a well-balanced manner.
[Set contents]
●Funnel trajectory effect × complete set ●Clear stand × 1
[Compatible items]
HGUC NO.195 Qubeley (sold separately/2015 Release over-the-counter item)
* It also supports variation items using the same kit.
*It is not compatible with HGUC NO.4 Qubeley (1999 Release) or HGUC NO.11 Qubeley Mk-II (2000 Release).
★Linked item CHECK!! (sold separately)★
Compatible with joint with HGUC 1/144 Qubeley Mk-II (Pull Two exclusive machine) (Premium Bandai sales item).
This product is a joint product with the new REVIVE "HGUC 1/144 Qubeley (sold separately/currently being released in stores)".
A set of funnel trajectory effects and a stand to reproduce the funnel injection scene.
This product does not include the MS body.
*The funnel is included with the main product.
* In order to reproduce the posted photo, you will need compatible items such as this product and the new REVIVE "HGUC 1/144 Qubeley" (sold separately).
Also, "HGUC 1/144 Qubeley" (sold separately) is not available for sale at Premium Bandai.
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. The main product (sold separately) is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Due to the manufacturing process, air bubbles may appear in the clear parts.
(remarks)
・This product cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・This product may be sold at events sponsored by our company or other projects, or overseas.
・ There is a limited number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai'. Please note that the item may be out of stock.
・Due to production availability, we are limiting the quantity of this product that can be purchased per person.
